item.guildmark.pack_harness.hint: Use it on a tame donkey, mule or llama of yours.
item.guildmark.pack_harness.hint2: Sneak and use it on a harnessed one to take it off.
item.guildmark.drovers_whistle.hint: Blow it to call your pack animals to follow.
item.guildmark.drovers_whistle.hint2: Sneak and blow it to have them stay.
message.guildmark.trade.pack.not_yours_u: That is somebody else's pack animal.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.kind: A harness fits a donkey, a mule or a llama.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.baby: It is too young to carry a pack.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.untamed: It has to be tame first.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.not_your: That animal belongs to somebody else.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.busy: Not while it is being ridden.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.failed: The straps will not go on.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.already: It wears a harness already. Sneak to take it off.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.none_com: You whistle, but no pack animal of yours is near enough to hear.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.one_come: Your pack animal lifts its head and comes.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.many_com: %s pack animals lift their heads and come.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.none_sta: You whistle low, but no pack animal of yours is near enough to hear.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.one_stay: Your pack animal stays where it is.
message.guildmark.trade.whistle.many_sta: %s pack animals stay where they are.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.short: You have not the Marks for that.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.away: Step up to the hall's counter first.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.gone: The counter does not sell that.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.failed: That could not be handed over; your Marks are as they were.
ware.guildmark.pack_harness.line: Straps, panniers and a whistle to call by
ware.guildmark.pack_harness.tip: Buckle it on a tame donkey, mule or llama and it follows you carrying your goods, its bell tinkling as it walks. Comes with a Drover's Whistle: blow it to call your animals, sneak and blow it to have them stay.
ware.guildmark.pack_donkey.line: Tame, willing and yours from the click
ware.guildmark.pack_donkey.tip: A donkey that is tame and yours already, brought round from the yard by the town's carter. It comes without a harness.
